nodes.name: test_execution_guards.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the execution guard layer, verifying run_guard approves clean trades and blocks on position-size and withdrawal-enabled predicates, and that captured config overrides environment.

nodes.name: _admit
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds an admitting RuntimeDecisionRecord fixture used to assert that a blocked guard produces no fill record.

nodes.name: test_feature_builder.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the v0 feature builder, asserting exact level/spread values, snapshot/version anchoring, provenance propagation, determinism, and fail-closed behaviour on missing input series.

nodes.name: test_decision_builder.py
nodes.summary: Golden-path tests for the decision builder: pinned policy fingerprints, byte-identical replay, packet-id stability, fail-closed snapshot-id mismatch, guard-ref forwarding, and config validation invariants.

nodes.name: _make_fv
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic FeatureVector with overridable and droppable feature values for exercising the decision builder under controlled inputs.

nodes.name: test_e2e_pipeline.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end pipeline tests chaining snapshot consume, feature build, regime classify, and decision build, asserting byte-identical replay, a golden packet, and unchanged snapshot-id/provenance flow.

nodes.name: _run_pipeline
nodes.summary: Helper that runs the full consume -> build_features -> classify -> build_decision chain over a fixture path, used as the common driver for the e2e assertions.

nodes.name: test_gold_bench.py
nodes.summary: Benchmark tests for the gold decision bench, asserting report determinism, byte-identical real replay, a pinned pass packet, full direction reachability, and that the committed artifact stays in sync.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Benchmark tests for the paper-runtime bench, checking deterministic reports, byte-identical sequences, idempotent duplicate rejects, full verdict coverage, reject attribution, and committed-artifact sync.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_determinism.py
nodes.summary: Determinism tests for the paper runtime evaluate path, asserting byte-identical records across runs, record-id binding to prior ledger state, pinned runtime policy fingerprint, and fingerprint threading into record ids.

nodes.name: _packet
nodes.summary: Constructs a GoldDecisionPacket fixture with parameterized snapshot id and direction for driving deterministic runtime evaluation tests.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_engine.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the paper runtime evaluation engine covering admit/reject/hold verdicts, canonical guard ordering, configurable guard requirements, supervisor stub behaviour, and RuntimeDecisionRecord construction invariants.

nodes.name: _packet
nodes.summary: Builds a GoldDecisionPacket fixture with snapshot id, direction, snapshot guards, and regime parameters for exercising the runtime engine verdict paths.

nodes.name: _record
nodes.summary: Constructs a RuntimeDecisionRecord fixture from a verdict and triggered-guard input, used to assert the admit/non-admit guard-naming invariants.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_guards.py
nodes.summary: Exhaustive tests of the individual paper-runtime guard predicates (duplicate, operational, data/freshness echo, cooldown) including fail-closed edge cases on missing or out-of-order timestamps.

nodes.name: _packet
nodes.summary: Builds a parameterized GoldDecisionPacket fixture (snapshot id, direction, guards, regime, instrument, as_of) for driving the guard predicate tests.

nodes.name: test_paper_runtime_ledger.py
nodes.summary: Tests the runtime ledger semantics: immutable append, length-derived sequencing, duplicate non-admit on re-presentation, stable state hash through serialization, and seq continuity across persist/reload.

nodes.name: _packet
nodes.summary: Constructs a GoldDecisionPacket fixture with parameterized snapshot id and direction for the ledger sequencing tests.

nodes.name: test_alpaca_clock_feed.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Alpaca clock feed: open/closed determination against a stub calendar, fail-closed on client errors or missing credentials, paper-only base-url enforcement, and capture/replay round-trips.

nodes.name: _StubCalendar
nodes.summary: Test double exposing a fixed set of trading days so the Alpaca clock feed can be exercised deterministically without a live client.

nodes.name: test_chain_bench.py
nodes.summary: Benchmark tests for the chain orchestrator bench, asserting deterministic and byte-identical replays, corpus-grounded admits, idempotent reject-no-fill behaviour, complete replay keys, declared measures, and pinned hashes.

nodes.name: test_chain_determinism.py
nodes.summary: Determinism tests for the chain runtime, asserting byte-identical sequence replay, end-to-end idempotency, replay ignoring os.environ, and run_once persist/reload round-trips on disk.

nodes.name: test_chain_engine.py
nodes.summary: Tests the chain orchestration engine end-to-end: admit-no-fill chains, in-hand price/direction forwarding, packet purity, ledger advancement, guard-block attribution, fail-closed admits, and bounded-context import hygiene.

nodes.name: test_operational_feed.py
nodes.summary: Tests the operational (market-calendar) feed: open/closed/holiday determination, fail-closed parsing, capture round-trips through load_operational, value freezing, and replay never re-reading the feed.

nodes.name: _StubFeed
nodes.summary: Test double that returns a scripted sequence of operational inputs so capture/replay behaviour can be verified independent of a real calendar feed.

nodes.name: test_regime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Benchmark tests for the regime classifier bench, asserting deterministic reports, byte-identical real replay, a restrictive-rates fail-closed gate, full synthetic sweep coverage, and committed-artifact sync.

nodes.name: test_regime_classifier.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive regime-classifier suite covering every rule's firing conditions, priority ordering, threshold boundaries, indeterminate/neutral invariants, config from_mapping validation, secondary-match ordering, and provenance propagation.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of pytest parametrization to sweep a rule grid and assert exactly-one-valid-label per cell.

nodes.name: make_fv
nodes.summary: Builds a FeatureVector fixture with overridable values, droppable features, and configurable snapshot/schema version for driving the regime classifier across its rule grid.

nodes.name: _valid_kwargs
nodes.summary: Returns a baseline mapping of valid feature kwargs that individual regime tests selectively override to isolate a single rule's firing condition.

nodes.name: test_guardrail_engine.py
nodes.summary: Tests the risk guardrail engine: approval when all predicates pass, blocking with named predicate on oversized/malformed requests, short-circuit on first failure, determinism, env config loading, and the blocked-without-predicate decision invariant.

nodes.name: make_config
nodes.summary: Builds a GuardrailConfig fixture from an overridable baseline of limits for exercising the guardrail engine.

nodes.name: make_request
nodes.summary: Builds a TradeValidationRequest fixture from an overridable baseline used across the guardrail engine assertions.

nodes.name: test_predicates.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the individual risk predicates (position size, daily loss cap, max trades, max positions, withdrawal disabled), verifying pass/block boundaries and absolute-vs-percentage cap selection.

nodes.name: make_config
nodes.summary: Builds a GuardrailConfig fixture from an overridable baseline of risk limits for the predicate-level tests.

nodes.name: make_request
nodes.summary: Builds a TradeValidationRequest fixture from an overridable baseline for exercising each risk predicate in isolation.

nodes.name: test_consumer.py
nodes.summary: Tests the snapshot consumer: returns a pass snapshot, reports consumability, fail-closed rejection of forced/dry-run snapshots, no output on failed gate or absent file, and raising rather than silent None on malformed input.

nodes.name: test_models.py
nodes.summary: Tests Snapshot.from_dict parsing of a real artifact: top-level fields, recomputed-id matches published, full-fidelity series values, guards and quality summary parsing, and raises on missing keys or non-object payloads.

nodes.name: test_decision_engine.py
nodes.summary: Tests the supervisor decision engine: early exit when promotable, highest-scoring allowed selection with treasury burn, budget and exclusion filtering, determinism, and the selected-must-be-allowed packet invariant.

nodes.name: test_scoring.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for supervisor scoring: calibration and binary pnl weakness severity, zero for unknown dimensions, cost-efficiency-weighted option scoring, and rejection of non-positive cost.

nodes.name: Position Sizing.md
nodes.summary: Execution-domain wiki page defining position sizing: standard parameters, sizing logic, environment-based configuration, ladder/scale-in buying, inputs/outputs, dependencies, and failure modes.

nodes.name: Stop-Loss Systems.md
nodes.summary: Execution-domain wiki page describing stop-loss systems: fixed, trailing (with floor-ratcheting logic), and time-based stops, per-strategy configuration, midday stop management, inputs/outputs, and failure modes.
